_note: Transparent planning assumptions. 'basis' says where each number comes from: 'guideline' = taken from the cited source; 'prometheus' = a Prometheus planning default you can change. These are planning targets, not medical or nutritional advice.

food.note: Energy needs vary with age, sex, size and activity. 2,000 kcal/adult is a common planning reference; children's needs range widely (roughly 1,000-2,400 kcal), so 1,600 is a middle planning value. Food only counts toward this target when its kcal per unit is recorded.

targets.label: Drinking & sanitation water
targets.explain: At least ~1 US gallon (3.8 L) per person per day for drinking and sanitation. Needs can double in very hot conditions; children, nursing mothers and sick people may need more. Pet water is a Prometheus planning default.

targets.label: Shelf-stable food energy
targets.explain: Daily energy per person × days. Store non-perishable food your household will actually eat, accounting for dietary needs.

targets.label: Pet food
targets.explain: One pet-day of food per pet per day of the plan.

targets.label: Prescription medication supply
targets.explain: Enough of each regular medication to cover the plan. Talk to your doctor or pharmacist about safe stock levels and storage.

targets.label: First aid kit
targets.explain: A stocked first aid kit, checked regularly.

targets.label: Torch / flashlight
targets.explain: One torch per person (minimum two) so nobody moves around in the dark. Avoid candles where possible.

targets.label: Spare batteries (sets)
targets.explain: Roughly one spare set of batteries per person per week for torches and radio.

targets.label: Battery or wind-up radio
targets.explain: Lets you receive official emergency broadcasts when mobile data and power are down.

targets.label: Phone power bank
targets.explain: Keep phones charged for emergency calls and alerts.

targets.label: Manual can opener
targets.explain: Needed for canned food when electric openers don't work.

targets.label: Garbage bags & ties (sanitation)
targets.explain: Ready.gov lists garbage bags and plastic ties for personal sanitation; one bag per person per day is a Prometheus planning default.

targets.label: Toilet paper
targets.explain: About one roll per person every five days (planning default).

targets.label: Soap / hand sanitiser
targets.explain: Hand hygiene prevents illness when water for washing is limited.

targets.label: Copies of important documents
targets.explain: ID, insurance, medical information and emergency contacts in a waterproof bag.
